L1 · caveat: Current regime unresolved: since 20 Nov 2024 +4.92 bps a week, t 1.42 over 98 weeks (68 of them SENSEX alone); within instruments the shift is +3.43 bps (t 0.89), so the drop is mostly composition, not decay; the 95% interval (-1.9 to +11.7) does not exclude zero, and about 303 weeks would be needed to detect +4.92 at 80% power. Test: the forward sleeves, read as a check of the entry and settlement links rather than of the mean

L2 · caveat: Not robust under sensitivity (v2): t 1.58 on weeks with two or more instruments; without FINNIFTY +3.17 bps, t 1.84; since 20 Nov 2024 +2.30 bps, t 0.84; 2024 negative. It passed its registered test, so it stays replicated, but the desk should not lean on it. Test: stock options (BACKLOG 1)
L2 · caveat: Thin cost margin: break-even at 6.6x the modelled costs on v2 (4.1x since Nov 2024); the 5-delta wings are where real spreads are widest. Test: the cost gap measured by sleeves C and E
